name: TUKAN
description: "This compact 2-way speaker system is ideal not only for the main system but also for the rear of subsystems and surround systems.A 12.5 cm cone type woofer is used for the low range.It uses an aluminum die-cast frame and is magnetic resistant by double magnet.The high-frequency range uses a 1.9 cm ceramic dome type tweeter, the same as the Celtic, the highest class speaker system of LINN at that time.Equipped with a rear cap to prevent the effects of sound pressure changes inside the enclosure.A strong glass fiber substrate is used for the network part.In addition, it can be easily upgraded to a multi-amplifier system by the exclusive active module sold separately.The speaker jacks support bi-wiring.An enclosure made of MDF material and a grill structure without frame realizes a reproduction sound without coloring.Low-frequency reproduction is achieved by using Caseton block with excellent sound absorption characteristics.There are 2 types of models, walnut and black, with a veneer finish.Bra kit with wall mounting metal fittings is sold separately and the mounting angle is adjustable."
